claim: 你單靠自己較難施展，要有外來的助力扶持，才發揮得出來。
en: On your own you find it hard to get going; you need outside support to show what you can do.
limit: 原文說丑未天機本為弱垣，須仗其他星曜扶持；關鍵在天機得祿。

claim: 你的盤偏上進：得到助力的時候，你能力爭上游。
en: Your chart leans upward: when support is there, you strive to climb.

claim: 你的盤偏停滯：不容易自己往上走，要靠後天的努力補救。
en: Your chart leans toward standing still: you do not climb easily on your own, and need deliberate effort to make up for it.

claim: 你適合離開出生地發展，到外面往往更能發跡。
en: You do well to leave your birthplace; away from home you are more likely to rise.
limit: 原文「天梁加吉坐遷移」：對宮天梁會合良好、有吉化吉會。這裡以命宮三方四正見吉化又見輔佐計。

claim: 你擅長說話，口才是你的長處。
en: You are a good talker; eloquence is one of your strengths.

claim: 你的口才容易變成口舌是非，適宜用在靠說話謀生的工作上。
en: Your way with words can turn into quarrels and gossip; it is best put to use in work where you earn a living by talking.

claim: 你是做計劃、研究的人才，不宜只當生意人看待。
en: You are a planner and researcher at heart, not simply a trader.

claim: 你常日夜奔忙，到了晚上仍在計劃思量。
en: You are often busy day and night, still planning and thinking things over late into the evening.
limit: 原文「太陰守身宮」，丑未天機的太陰必在福德；不見煞方說可成富格，這裡只說較易累積。

claim: 你做生意，有條件累積起可觀的財富。
en: In business you have what it takes to build up considerable wealth.
limit: 原文「太陰守身宮…不見煞，經商可成富格」。

claim: 你的想法獨特，但不容易被人理解；身邊有能支持你的同輩和長輩，你才站得穩。
en: Your thinking is original but not easily understood; you stand firm only with supportive peers and elders around you.
limit: 原文另有天才同度主智慧極高，引擎冇天才。

claim: {decades}這幾個十年，是你一生運程的關鍵。
en: The years {decades} are the turning points of your life.

claim: 這十年運勢不俗。
en: This decade goes reasonably well for you.

claim: 這一年有獨當一面的機會，最宜用來改變處境。
en: This year offers a chance to take charge on your own; it is the best time to change your circumstances.

claim: 這一年不宜貿然自立創業，要看清之後幾年的形勢再決定。
en: This year is not the time to strike out on your own in a hurry; look at how the following years shape up before deciding.

claim: 這十年寧靜順遂。
en: This decade is calm and smooth for you.

claim: 這十年宜慢慢發展，不急於名利，就能扭轉往後的運勢。
en: In this decade, build slowly and do not chase fame or gain; that can turn your later fortunes around.

claim: 這十年稍帶波折。
en: This decade brings some ups and downs.

claim: 這十年你往往經不起挫折，容易從此變得不求上進。
en: In this decade setbacks can wear you down, and you may stop striving afterwards.

claim: 這十年會有突如其來的際遇。
en: This decade brings sudden opportunities.

claim: 這十年你不易守住突來的好處，容易暴起暴跌。
en: This decade you may not hold on to sudden gains; quick rises can be followed by quick falls.

claim: 這十年容易失意。
en: This decade tends to bring disappointment.
limit: 原文「煞忌刑耗諸惡同躔」：計同度羊陀空劫天刑化忌兩項或以上；引擎冇耗。

claim: 這十年你受的挫敗會更大。
en: The setbacks of this decade hit you harder.

claim: 這十年容易得人提拔，平步青雲。
en: This decade others are likely to promote you, and you can rise smoothly.

claim: 這十年是你轉變命運的樞紐，不可輕易錯過機會。
en: This decade is a hinge for changing your fortunes; do not let the chance slip.

claim: 這十年容易因求變而生破敗。
en: In this decade, seeking change easily leads to setbacks.

claim: 這十年是能大展拳腳的佳運。
en: This decade is a good run in which you can really spread your wings.

claim: 這十年應當作扭轉命運的機會。
en: Treat this decade as a chance to turn your fortunes around.

claim: 這十年謀求發展容易有成；計劃時留有餘地，就能保持。
en: This decade efforts to grow tend to succeed; leave yourself room in your plans and you can keep what you gain.

claim: 這十年容易惹是非紛爭。
en: This decade tends to draw you into disputes.

claim: 這十年是容易傾敗的運，不宜求變。
en: This decade is prone to collapse; it is not the time to seek change.

claim: 這十年可以求變。
en: This decade you can seek change.

claim: 這十年要先換工作環境，運勢才會轉好。
en: This decade things improve only after you change your working environment.

claim: 這十年氣質和你相投，是你開創的運。
en: This decade suits your temperament and is a time for starting things.
note: 原文「見／會／遇吉化」：讀做同宮（同度）嘅星本命或大限化祿權科（A9，2026-10-19）。

claim: 這十年你雖想自主，往往仍受人指使利用。
en: In this decade, though you want to act for yourself, you are often directed and used by others.

claim: 這十年必有很大的挫折。
en: This decade is bound to bring a major setback.

claim: 這十年是你發跡的運。
en: This decade is when you rise.

claim: 這十年最利你進取。
en: This decade is best for pushing ahead.
note: 原文「見／會／遇吉化」：讀做同宮（同度）嘅星本命或大限化祿權科（A9，2026-10-19）。

claim: 這十年你可能安於現狀，錯失力爭上游的機會。
en: This decade you may settle for what you have and miss the chance to climb.
note: 原文「見／會／遇吉化」：讀做同宮（同度）嘅星本命或大限化祿權科（A9，2026-10-19）。

claim: 這一年容易有口舌是非。
en: This year you are prone to quarrels and gossip.

claim: 這十年更見艱辛挫折。
en: This decade brings even more hardship and setbacks.

claim: 這十年要主動靠人事補救，任由運勢發展，後果堪虞。
en: In this decade you need to act to repair things; leaving it to fate could end badly.

claim: 這十年縱有波瀾，你也必有長足進步。
en: This decade, waves or no waves, you will make real progress.

claim: 這十年的運勢你未必把握得住。
en: This decade you may not manage to make the most of your luck.
